exposure: Fathers' participation in the Preemie Prep for Parents (P3) program
P3 intervention (text-messages linking to animated videos)
outcome: Knowledge of unmarried fathers' legal neonatal decision-making ability
cohort: The study included opposite-sex cohabitating couples where the mother had one or more medical conditions predisposing to preterm birth.
finding: Among mothers receiving the P3 intervention, those whose fathers participated had greater knowledge, and parents viewing the fathers' rights video were more likely to know about unmarried fathers' legal neonatal decision-making ability.
